newsitem.title: UK: Standard Chart up on broker "buy" ratings.
newsitem.headline: Standard Chart up on broker "buy" ratings.

text.p: Shares in Standard Chartered Plc rose on Wednesday as analysts at SBC Warburg and SocGen issued "buy" recommendations on the stock, dealers said.

Earlier today Standard posted a 32 percent rise in pre-tax profit to 870 million stg, at the top of the range of analyst expectations. The stock was up 22p at 792 by 1120 GMT in active trade of 5.3 million shares.

Analysts at neither SocGen or Warburg were immediately available for comment. Standard Chartered shares have retreated since hitting a record 829p on February 10. -- David Holmes, London Newsroom +44 171 542 4376
